name: leetcode-capture-extension
description: MV3 content script that captures LeetCode Run/Submit attempts - no build step, no dependencies. This package.json exists to run content.test.js and to alias the web-ext (AMO tooling) commands in AMO_SUBMISSION_CHECKLIST.md - web-ext itself is fetched on demand via npx, not a declared dependency, so this stays dependency-free.

scripts.test: node --test content.test.js panel.test.js shared.test.js adapters.test.mjs engine.test.mjs helper-launcher.test.mjs layout-bridge.test.js build.test.mjs roadmap.test.mjs solved.test.mjs problem-index.test.mjs practice.test.mjs reply-guard.test.mjs
scripts.build:chrome: node scripts/build.mjs --browser chrome && npx --yes web-ext build --source-dir ../dist/chrome --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --filename "leetcode_capture-chrome-{version}.zip" --overwrite-dest
